describedBy.text: The diff never weakens the compiler or template contract to make new code build: `strict`, `strictTemplates`, `noImplicitOverride`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch` and the ESLint rule set stay at least as strict as they were, and no file is added to an `exclude`/ignore list for that purpose — a flag turned off hides the same class of error in every other file of the repo.

Linter rules are clean before commit; state-management lint rules (`@ngrx/*`) are errors, not warnings. Prettier-owned formatting (indentation, wrapping, quotes, semicolons, trailing commas, spacing, blank lines) is NEVER a finding — the formatter fixes it mechanically.

instructions.name: Security
instructions.gate: the file carries something a security rule can bite - code, markup, configuration or data; a pure re-export barrel (only `export * from` lines) carries none of it

items.text: No secrets in the diff: API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings or private endpoints — not in code, configs, environment files, tests or comments, not even "temporarily".
